title: Cleaning Sessions
subtitle: 「清潔時段／清潔活動／清潔輪次」，要先分清是時間、活動、員工班次，還是程序循環。
description: 「清潔時段／清潔活動／清潔輪次」，要先分清是時間、活動、員工班次，還是程序循環。

words.meaning: 預定清潔時段；安排好的清潔時間
words.example: The laboratory has scheduled cleaning periods between practical classes.
words.exampleZh: 實驗室在實驗課之間設有預定清潔時段。

exercises.original: The laboratory has cleaning sessions between practical classes.
exercises.zh: 實驗室在實驗課之間設有清潔時段。
exercises.upgrade: The laboratory has scheduled cleaning periods between practical classes.

options.explanation: between practical classes 顯示這些是預先安排、固定插入的清潔時段。
schedule 是整張時間表，不是其中一次實際清潔時段。
範圍太廣，可能包括維修和檢查。
檢查狀況，不等於實際清潔。
過窄，原句只說 cleaning，不一定專門消毒。

exercises.original: The facility closes briefly for cleaning sessions every afternoon.
exercises.zh: 設施每天下午短暫關閉以進行預定清潔。
exercises.upgrade: The facility closes briefly for scheduled cleaning periods every afternoon.

options.explanation: 也可描述做甚麼，但 closes briefly 更突出固定時間段。
every afternoon + closes briefly 明確是安排好的時間區間。
是偶爾大掃除，不會每日發生。
對一般 facility 過於特定。

exercises.original: The timetable includes two cleaning sessions each day.
exercises.zh: 時間表每天包括兩個清潔時段。
exercises.upgrade: The timetable includes two scheduled cleaning periods each day.

options.explanation: timetable + two each day 是最直接的時段安排。
service 是整體服務，不是兩個時段。
可能包括其他保養工作。
不是時間表中的正式時段名稱。

words.example: Volunteers take part in cleaning activities every Saturday.
words.exampleZh: 義工每逢星期六參與清潔活動。

exercises.original: Volunteers take part in cleaning sessions every Saturday.
exercises.zh: 義工每逢星期六參與清潔活動。
exercises.upgrade: Volunteers take part in cleaning activities every Saturday.

options.explanation: volunteers take part in 表示重點是參與清潔工作本身。
社區義工清潔不一定屬房務。

exercises.original: Students complete cleaning sessions after the event.
exercises.zh: 學生在活動後進行清潔工作。
exercises.upgrade: Students complete cleaning activities after the event.

options.explanation: after the event 的清潔工作是最自然概括。
一般指季節性／大型大掃除。

exercises.original: The programme includes weekly cleaning sessions around the neighbourhood.
exercises.zh: 計劃包括每週社區清潔活動。
exercises.upgrade: The programme includes weekly cleaning activities around the neighbourhood.

options.explanation: neighbourhood + weekly programme 強調實際共同清潔行動。
只是一種特定衛生處理。

words.example: The pool closes briefly for a cleaning period in the afternoon.
words.exampleZh: 泳池下午會短暫關閉一段時間進行清潔。

exercises.original: The pool closes for short cleaning sessions in the afternoon.
exercises.zh: 泳池下午會短暫關閉進行清潔。
exercises.upgrade: The pool closes for short cleaning periods in the afternoon.

options.explanation: pool closes for short periods，重點是關閉的一段時間。

exercises.original: The venue has a thirty-minute cleaning session after closing.
exercises.zh: 場地關閉後有三十分鐘清潔時段。
exercises.upgrade: The venue has a thirty-minute cleaning period after closing.

options.explanation: 有活動感，但 thirty-minute after closing 更像營運清潔時段。
shift 是員工班次，也加入維修含義。

exercises.original: There is a cleaning session between the morning and afternoon bookings.
exercises.zh: 早上和下午預約之間有一段清潔時間。
exercises.upgrade: There is a cleaning period between the morning and afternoon bookings.

options.explanation: between bookings 正是兩段使用之間的清潔時間。

words.example: The class has ten minutes of cleaning time before lunch.
words.exampleZh: 班級在午飯前有十分鐘清潔時間。

exercises.original: The class has a short cleaning session before lunch.
exercises.zh: 班級午飯前有短暫清潔時間。
exercises.upgrade: The class has a short cleaning time before lunch.

options.explanation: classroom + before lunch 是日常、簡潔的時間說法。
會加入設備保養等更廣工作。
不會是每日午飯前的短時段。

exercises.original: We set aside twenty minutes for a cleaning session at the end of the day.
exercises.zh: 我們每天結束前預留二十分鐘清潔時間。
exercises.upgrade: We set aside twenty minutes for cleaning time at the end of the day.

options.explanation: 可說做甚麼，但 set aside twenty minutes 最自然是 cleaning time。
直接表示被預留的一段時間。

exercises.original: The children know that the final ten minutes are a cleaning session.
exercises.zh: 孩子們知道最後十分鐘是清潔時間。
exercises.upgrade: The children know that the final ten minutes are cleaning time.

options.explanation: final ten minutes 是非常日常的時間分配表達。

words.meaning: 巡迴清潔；例行清潔輪次
words.example: Staff complete cleaning rounds every two hours in the station.
words.exampleZh: 員工每兩小時在車站完成一輪清潔。

exercises.original: Station staff carry out cleaning sessions every two hours throughout the building.
exercises.zh: 車站員工每兩小時在大樓進行一輪清潔。
exercises.upgrade: Station staff carry out cleaning rounds every two hours throughout the building.

options.explanation: every two hours + throughout the building 表示員工巡迴不同位置清潔。
是時間安排，不是實際巡迴工作。
車站不一定用房務概念。

exercises.original: Hospital staff complete several cleaning sessions on each floor every day.
exercises.zh: 醫院員工每天在每層完成多輪清潔。
exercises.upgrade: Hospital staff complete several cleaning rounds on each floor every day.

options.explanation: 是較大的制度，不是 several times on each floor 的具體輪次。
floor-by-floor repeated work 是典型 rounds。

exercises.original: The hotel increases cleaning sessions in public areas during busy periods.
exercises.zh: 酒店在繁忙時段增加公共區域的巡迴清潔。
exercises.upgrade: The hotel increases cleaning rounds in public areas during busy periods.

options.explanation: public areas + increases frequency during busy periods 表示重複巡迴。
可能包括客房工作，過窄／方向不同。
是計劃，不是增加實際輪次。

words.meaning: 清理活動；清潔行動時段
words.example: The school organises monthly clean-up sessions around the campus.
words.exampleZh: 學校每月在校園舉辦清理活動。

exercises.original: The school organises monthly cleaning sessions around the campus.
exercises.zh: 學校每月在校園舉辦清理活動。
exercises.upgrade: The school organises monthly clean-up sessions around the campus.

options.explanation: school organises + around campus 有集體整理／清垃圾的活動感。
通常用於住宿／房務，不適合整個校園清理。

exercises.original: Volunteers joined a cleaning session at the beach on Sunday.
exercises.zh: 義工星期日參加海灘清理活動。
exercises.upgrade: Volunteers joined a clean-up session at the beach on Sunday.

options.explanation: volunteers + beach 是非常典型的 organised clean-up。
只說時間，失去義工活動感。
義工活動不是工作班次。

exercises.original: The neighbourhood group runs cleaning sessions after large community events.
exercises.zh: 社區組織在大型活動後舉辦清理活動。
exercises.upgrade: The neighbourhood group runs clean-up sessions after large community events.

options.explanation: neighbourhood group + after events 明確是共同清理場地。

words.meaning: 房務清潔時段；日常整理清潔活動
words.example: Guest rooms are unavailable during morning housekeeping sessions.
words.exampleZh: 客房在早上房務清潔時段暫停使用。

exercises.original: Guest rooms are unavailable during morning cleaning sessions.
exercises.zh: 客房在早上房務清潔時段暫停使用。
exercises.upgrade: Guest rooms are unavailable during morning housekeeping sessions.

options.explanation: guest rooms + morning cleaning 是典型酒店房務。
更像集體整理活動，不如 housekeeping 專業。

exercises.original: The hostel schedules cleaning sessions for bedrooms every morning.
exercises.zh: 宿舍每天早上安排房務清潔。
exercises.upgrade: The hostel schedules housekeeping sessions for bedrooms every morning.

options.explanation: 若是巡房也可，但 bedrooms + hostel 日常房務更適合 housekeeping。
包含清潔、整理床鋪等住宿設施常規工作。

exercises.original: The residence has cleaning sessions before new guests arrive.
exercises.zh: 住宿設施在新住客抵達前進行房務清潔。
exercises.upgrade: The residence has housekeeping sessions before new guests arrive.

options.explanation: guest turnover 是典型住宿房務語境。

words.meaning: 衛生清潔時段；衛生處理活動
words.example: The kitchen closes briefly for sanitation sessions between service periods.
words.exampleZh: 廚房在不同服務時段之間短暫關閉，以進行衛生清潔。

exercises.original: The kitchen closes between service periods for cleaning sessions.
exercises.zh: 廚房在不同服務時段之間關閉進行衛生清潔。
exercises.upgrade: The kitchen closes between service periods for sanitation sessions.

options.explanation: kitchen + between service periods 強調食品衛生標準。
可能是設備維修，不等同衛生清潔。
不如 sanitation 適合商用廚房衛生。

exercises.original: The food-preparation area has mandatory cleaning sessions after each shift.
exercises.zh: 食品準備區每更後都有強制衛生清潔時段。
exercises.upgrade: The food-preparation area has mandatory sanitation sessions after each shift.

options.explanation: 也可，但 food-preparation + mandatory 強調衛生標準，sanitation 更精準。
適合食品安全和衛生程序。

exercises.original: The clinic adds extra cleaning sessions during flu season.
exercises.zh: 診所在流感季增加衛生清潔時段。
exercises.upgrade: The clinic adds extra sanitation sessions during flu season.

options.explanation: clinic + flu season 明確需要衛生／感染控制取向。
可包括日常房務，但沒有 sanitation 的衛生焦點。

words.meaning: 清潔更次；清潔工作班次
words.example: Two teams cover the overnight cleaning shifts at the airport.
words.exampleZh: 兩隊員工負責機場的通宵清潔班次。

exercises.original: Two teams cover the overnight cleaning sessions at the airport.
exercises.zh: 兩隊員工負責機場通宵清潔班次。
exercises.upgrade: Two teams cover the overnight cleaning shifts at the airport.

options.explanation: two teams + overnight + cover 明確是員工排班。
只表示時間，未突出員工班次。

exercises.original: Staff rotate through evening cleaning sessions each week.
exercises.zh: 員工每週輪流負責晚間清潔班次。
exercises.upgrade: Staff rotate through evening cleaning shifts each week.

options.explanation: 強調巡迴，不強調員工輪班。
staff rotate through 是 shift 的典型線索。

exercises.original: The hotel assigns extra cleaning sessions to staff during peak season.
exercises.zh: 酒店在旺季安排額外清潔班次給員工。
exercises.upgrade: The hotel assigns extra cleaning shifts to staff during peak season.

options.explanation: 也可能，但 assigns ... to staff + peak season 更突出排班。

words.meaning: 預定清理活動；安排好的清潔行動
words.example: The park has scheduled clean-ups after major events.
words.exampleZh: 公園在大型活動後會安排預定清理工作。

exercises.original: The park has cleaning sessions after major events.
exercises.zh: 公園在大型活動後安排清理工作。
exercises.upgrade: The park has scheduled clean-ups after major events.

options.explanation: after major events 表示每次活動後都有預定清理行動。

exercises.original: The venue arranges cleaning sessions immediately after concerts.
exercises.zh: 場地在演唱會後立即安排清理活動。
exercises.upgrade: The venue arranges scheduled clean-ups immediately after concerts.

options.explanation: concerts 後恢復場地整潔，是典型 clean-up。

exercises.original: The campus timetable includes cleaning sessions after student fairs.
exercises.zh: 校園時間表包括學生市集後的清理活動。
exercises.upgrade: The campus timetable includes scheduled clean-ups after student fairs.

options.explanation: 像外判服務，不是 timetable 中的事件。
timetable + after fairs 是預先安排的清理事件。
不適合整個校園活動後清理。

words.example: Routine cleaning sessions take place after the building closes.
words.exampleZh: 大樓關閉後會進行例行清潔時段。

exercises.original: The office carries out cleaning sessions every evening as part of normal operations.
exercises.zh: 辦公室每晚進行例行清潔。
exercises.upgrade: The office carries out routine cleaning sessions every evening.

options.explanation: every evening + normal operations 直接表示例行清潔。
深層清潔通常不會每天進行。

exercises.original: The school has regular cleaning sessions after classes.
exercises.zh: 學校放學後有例行清潔時段。
exercises.upgrade: The school has routine cleaning sessions after classes.

options.explanation: 若員工巡迴可用，但 regular after classes 的核心是 routine。
regular + after classes 是標準例行清潔。

exercises.original: Daily cleaning sessions keep the shared kitchen tidy.
exercises.zh: 每日例行清潔令共用廚房保持整潔。
exercises.upgrade: Routine cleaning sessions keep the shared kitchen tidy.

options.explanation: 可能是其中一部分，但 tidy 不一定涉及消毒。
daily + keep tidy 是例行清潔的核心。
每日 deep clean 不自然。

words.meaning: 深層清潔時段；徹底清潔活動
words.example: The centre closes early once a month for deep-cleaning sessions.
words.exampleZh: 中心每月有一次提早關閉，以進行深層清潔。

exercises.original: The centre closes early once a month for intensive cleaning sessions.
exercises.zh: 中心每月有一次提早關閉，以進行深層清潔。
exercises.upgrade: The centre closes early once a month for deep-cleaning sessions.

options.explanation: once a month + intensive 表示不是一般每日清潔。
intensive, periodic cleaning 正是 deep cleaning。

exercises.original: The kitchen undergoes longer cleaning sessions at the end of each month.
exercises.zh: 廚房每月底進行較長的深層清潔。
exercises.upgrade: The kitchen undergoes deep-cleaning sessions at the end of each month.

options.explanation: 也可能涉及衛生，但 longer monthly cleaning 更突出 deep clean。
月底較長、較徹底的清潔最貼切。

exercises.original: The carpets receive special cleaning sessions twice a year.
exercises.zh: 地氈每年兩次接受特別深層清潔。
exercises.upgrade: The carpets receive deep-cleaning sessions twice a year.

options.explanation: twice a year + special 顯示不是日常清潔。
carpets 常需要週期性徹底清潔。
一年兩次未必與春季有關。

words.example: The machine runs an automatic cleaning cycle after every batch.
words.exampleZh: 機器每完成一批生產後會自動運行清潔循環。

exercises.original: The machine runs a cleaning session automatically after every batch.
exercises.zh: 機器每批生產後自動運行一次清潔循環。
exercises.upgrade: The machine runs an automatic cleaning cycle after every batch.

options.explanation: machine + automatically + after every batch 是標準自動清潔循環。

exercises.original: The equipment has three programmed cleaning sessions each day.
exercises.zh: 設備每天有三次預設清潔循環。
exercises.upgrade: The equipment has three programmed cleaning cycles each day.

options.explanation: programmed + equipment + repeated sequence 是典型 cycle。
只表示時間，不突出機器程序。

exercises.original: The dishwasher starts a cleaning session when the self-clean mode is selected.
exercises.zh: 洗碗機選擇自潔模式後會開始清潔循環。
exercises.upgrade: The dishwasher starts a cleaning cycle when the self-clean mode is selected.

options.explanation: self-clean mode 是機器自動程序，cycle 最精準。

falseSynonyms.zh: 清潔時間表不等於一次 cleaning session cleaning schedule 是列出何時清潔的時間表；session 是其中一次實際清潔時段。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A schedule organises cleaning sessions; it is not one of the sessions.

falseSynonyms.zh: 清潔服務不等於 cleaning session cleaning service 是整體服務／業務；session 是一次具體清潔活動。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A cleaning service may provide many cleaning sessions.

falseSynonyms.zh: 維修保養不等於清潔 maintenance 可包括維修、檢查、潤滑和更換零件；cleaning 只是其中一種工作。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Cleaning may be part of maintenance, but maintenance is much broader.

falseSynonyms.zh: 檢查不等於清潔 inspection 是查看和評估狀況；它可以在清潔前後進行，但本身不是清潔。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An inspection checks condition; a cleaning session removes dirt or restores cleanliness.

falseSynonyms.zh: 消毒不等於一般 cleaning disinfection 專門降低／消滅病原體；一般 cleaning 主要去除污垢和雜物。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Cleaning and disinfection are related but technically different processes.

falseSynonyms.zh: 房務／日常整理比 cleaning 更廣 housekeeping 可包括整理、補充用品、鋪床和管理房間；不是所有 housekeeping 都是 cleaning。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Housekeeping can include cleaning, but it also covers other routine room-care tasks.

falseSynonyms.zh: 家務雜務不等於 cleaning sessions chores 可包括洗衣、煮食、倒垃圾等多種工作；清潔只是其中一類。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Cleaning can be a chore, but chores are a broader set of household tasks.

falseSynonyms.zh: 大掃除不等於一般 cleaning session spring cleaning 通常指偶爾進行的大規模徹底清潔；日常清潔時段通常不是。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Spring cleaning is an occasional major clean, not a general synonym for routine cleaning sessions.
